name: Larion and Muigin
label: Quest
description: Larion and Muigin: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: See Muigin over there? It's HIS fault we're lost!
I'm the one that knew the way, but he insisted he knew a shortcut, and we ended up here!
To make matters worse, now he keeps sending his crazy plant pests to annoy me. I'm so angry that I'm not planning on talking to him any time soon, but these pests are too much to handle.
Why don't we try to limit his supply, first thing. Go out and hunt some Bloodpetals, then return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Muigin needs to apologize first before I'll talk to him again!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks for your help, friend, but I'm afraid I have some bad news...
